input.title: ci: wire up the ai-review caller

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+name: ai-review
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    branches: [main]
+jobs:
+  review:
+    uses: some-org/ci-toolkit/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml@4c7f2ab91d83e560af2b7c94d1e8360a5c2f19bd
+    with:
+      toolkit_ref: 4c7f2ab91d83e560af2b7c94d1e8360a5c2f19bd
+    secrets:
+      LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}

note: Globally clean: trusted-base trigger, full-SHA pins both layers, explicit secret.
